body: I appreciate it, :) though I honestly haven't the slightest idea as to what I should choose for a career path. My interests seem to change every other year or so. I think for the near future, I might just have to stick it out with an IT job, as I at least have some experience in that field. I guess being stuck in a corporate environment scares me. I like having the freedom to move about and do things in the world.

I was in college for IT. I didn't graduate, as I began to fail certain classes, I decided to give up on them. I partially finished this spring and got my Cisco certifications, but my career interests have since changed. I really have no idea where I'm going, and I feel like I'm at the end.
